item.tib: phrin las thugs kyi gnas mchog g.yung drung gsang ba dbal ri drag po gnam lcags yang rdzong gi lung byang nges pa'i che ba g.yung drung 'khyil ba
item.coloph: ces gnas chen gsang ba yang rdzong kyi (gi) lung byang 'di ni/ snyigs ma'i dus su 'chi med yab sras kyi slob lam 'dzin pa kho bo gsang sngags gling pas dus snga phyi'i skabs dang 'brel bar shog dril du rtsa thor bkod pa rnams dang / phyis lcags khyi'i lor gnas zhal 'byed pa'i skabs nges gsal du byung ba rnams mchog sprul dam pa tshe dbang 'gyur med nas yi ge pa byas te bkod pa rnams/ de rjes bstan pa'i bdag po khod spungs skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dgongs bzhed ngor/ gnas de nyid sgrub sde chen po byang chub gling gi bsam gtan gyi khang bur dran pa'i bka' thang chen mo gtan la pheb pa dang 'brel bar lung byang snga phyi rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas bkod pa ste gsang chen gyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i btsas su gyur cig/
